harper: dropped a fresh mock for 'Version Details drawer' — shows a small safety shield pattern before destructive actions. goal: reduce accidental revert clicks while keeping rollforward path visible. figma: https://figma.redwood/version-drawer/7 devon: I like the safety shield. copy thought: use 'Revert to stable' rather than 'Rollback' to be clearer for non-engr audiences. leah: +1 for 'Revert to stable'. Also suggest a muted secondary line: 'Restores traffic to the last verified version; may cause brief errors for in-flight requests.' omar: accessibility check: when the drawer opens, set focus on the drawer title and announce via aria-live: 'Version details opened for Service Z'. keep the shield dialog as alertdialog with aria-describedby. zoe: heroic nit: safety shield UI could be a 2-step inline: click shield -> lightweight inline confirm (button + small type-to-confirm for prod). for A/B tests we can show a reversible 'Rollforward' CTA that starts a canary increase. harper: interesting — separate actions: Revert (destructive) vs Rollforward (non-destructive). labels: 'Revert to stable' and 'Increase canary to 50%'. devon: UI detail: show quick history mini-rail inside drawer: little stacked chips with timestamps and a tiny green dot for verified versions. chips must meet 4.5:1. leah: keyboard shortcuts idea: G/H to jump between timeline clusters; Shift+Enter to open selected version drawer; Ctrl+Shift+R to start revert flow (requires typing 'CONFIRM'). docs/help panel must list this and allow disabling. omar: aria snippet for handoff: ```html

Version details Service Z

Opened version details. Use G/H to move clusters, Enter to open.
``` zoe: microcopy for the safety shield: header 'Confirm revert', body 'This will restore traffic to vX.Y.Z. Type CONFIRM to proceed.' button label 'Revert to stable'. confirmation header should mirror the inline link text for consistency. harper: dev note: prefer showing a small 'preview' badge when hovering a historical version that shows the traffic split snapshot. but don't load diffs until user requests. privacy: only aggregate metrics. devon: good. i'll consolidate copy + accessibility notes and upload a final Figma frame by EOD tomorrow. ui-bot: created task #5234 for version-drawer-a11y-and-copy. harper: thanks team — next step: leah add shortcut doc section, omar paste aria snippets into Figma, zoe update tokens for chip contrast. aiming to handoff early next week. :white_check_mark:
